Dear [Lady Brandreth](/person/208),
I hope in time to accomplish meeting you and conferring about the [G F S](/organisation/23) affairs!
I have never had the specimen packet, not having been the Branch associate for Literature. I think [Miss Stanford](/person/2209) has it for Winchester Country and [Miss Carey](/person/2210) for the City

Yours sincerely
C.M.

Yonge
